description: Counts trainable parameters of a two-block pre-norm Transformer classifier: token embedding (V, D), per block a QKV Linear, an output Linear, a two-layer MLP and two bias-free RMSNorms, then a final RMSNorm and a Linear head to 1. All Linear layers have bias; positions are a non-trainable buffer.
code:
V, D, P_max = 100, 16, 20
qkv = <<BLANK:qkv>>        # Linear(D, 3*D)
attn_out = <<BLANK:out>>   # Linear(D, D)
mlp = <<BLANK:mlp>>        # Linear(D, 4*D) + Linear(4*D, D)
norms = <<BLANK:norms>>    # two RMSNorm vectors of length D, no bias
block = qkv + attn_out + mlp + norms
# embedding + two separate blocks + final RMSNorm + Linear(D, 1)
transformer_total = <<BLANK:total>>
# trainable position table of shape (P_max, D)
learned_extra = <<BLANK:extra>>

answers: V * D + block + block + D + D + 1

hints: A Linear layer with bias has in*out + out parameters; RMSNorm without bias has just D. Count the head, final norm and both blocks.
Block = QKV + output projection + MLP up + MLP down + two RMSNorms. The total is embedding + 2 blocks + final norm + head.
qkv = D*3*D + 3*D; attn_out = D*D + D; mlp = (D*4*D + 4*D) + (4*D*D + D); norms = 2*D; total = V*D + 2*block + D + (D + 1); extra = P_max*D
explanation: qkv = 816, attn_out = 272, mlp = 1088 + 1040 = 2128, norms = 32, so one block = 3248. Total = 1600 + 2*3248 + 16 + 17 = 8129. A trainable position table adds 20*16 = 320.

title: Transformer count: missing bias and block
description: Counts the trainable parameters of a two-block pre-norm Transformer classifier with biased Linear layers, bias-free RMSNorms and fixed (buffer) positions.
code:
# every Linear has a bias; RMSNorm has D parameters (no bias); positions are a buffer
V, D, P_max = 100, 16, 20
qkv = D * 3 * D + 3 * D
attn_out = D * D
mlp = (D * 4 * D + 4 * D) + (4 * D * D + D)
norms = 2 * D
block = qkv + attn_out + mlp + norms
transformer_total = V * D + block + D + (D + 1)
learned_extra = P_max * D

errors.explanation: The output projection is a Linear layer with bias, so D parameters are added.

fixes: transformer_total = V * D + block + block + D + (D + 1)
transformer_total = V * D + 2 * block + D + D + 1
errors.explanation: The model has two separate blocks with their own weights, so the block count is added twice.

hints: Compare with the stated architecture: biases and number of blocks.
Every Linear has a bias; blocks do not share parameters.
Add D to attn_out, and use 2 * block.

title: Transformer count: QKV, norms and positions
description: Counts per-block and extra parameters of the Transformer classifier: one fused QKV Linear, bias-free RMSNorms, and a learned position table replacing fixed sinusoids.
code:
# every Linear has a bias; RMSNorm has D parameters (no bias); positions are a buffer
V, D, P_max = 100, 16, 20
qkv = D * D + 3 * D
attn_out = D * D + D
mlp = (D * 4 * D + 4 * D) + (4 * D * D + D)
norms = 2 * 2 * D
block = qkv + attn_out + mlp + norms
transformer_total = V * D + 2 * block + D + (D + 1)
learned_extra = P_max * V

errors.explanation: Linear(D, 3*D) has D * 3D weights, not D * D.
The two RMSNorms have one trainable vector each and no bias, so 2 * D (not 4 * D).
The position table has shape (P_max, D), not (P_max, V).

hints: Three formulas contradict the architecture description.
Check each shape: Linear(D, 3D), RMSNorm without bias, table (P_max, D).
qkv: D * 3D weights; norms: 2 * D; extra: P_max * D.
